E05_R134_RESULT: FAST AND SLOW BOTH REMAIN ADMISSIBLE
display_result: Two conditional MHD families are physically resolved, but observational family selection remains unresolved.
directly_observed: Relative EIS Fe XIII response and local AIA brightness evolution; no uniquely associated propagating ridge or independently bounded 3-D alpha.
source_derived: Spectral line fitting and effective density conditional on atomic response and temperature; alternative published speed means; image calibration, timing and registration.
assumed: Spectroscopic/reference plasma assignments to the two MHD states, front association, thermal/ideal-MHD closure, field azimuth and any selected upstream motion or geometry.
why_both_survive: No retained independent jointly incompatible state-pair measurement excludes either checked family. Every retained source tuple supports examples of both; interval widening cannot exclude included witnesses. State association, reference interpretation and temperature remain shared assumptions.
alpha_role: A strong discriminator under the frozen R132 closure. Once unmeasured upstream normal motion is relaxed, alpha alone is not a sufficient discriminator; neither the frozen map nor its conditional precision result is changed.

alternative_discriminator.quantity: Signed total magnetic-field-strength change across the same identified upstream/downstream front states
alternative_discriminator.relation: For compression X>1, q=Bt_down/Bt_up=X(1-bn^2)/(1-X*bn^2). Ordinary fast: bn^2<1/X gives q>1. Ordinary slow: bn^2>1 gives 0<q<1. Continuity of Bn makes the sign of B_down^2-B_up^2 equal the sign of Bt_down^2-Bt_up^2.
alternative_discriminator.required_bounded_precision: epsilon_Bup + epsilon_Bdown < abs(B_down-B_up), with association and calibration errors included; require the entire interval to have one sign.
alternative_discriminator.uniform_precision: No uniform finite magnetic precision is certified over the full continuous uncertain families, including unresolved/degenerate limits. Sampled minima are not lower bounds on all surviving physical states.
alternative_discriminator.credit: Standard ideal-MHD tangential momentum/induction and ordinary characteristic ordering; RMO tests their observational diagnostic use, not a new MHD law.

minimum_additional_observation: An independently associated same-front upstream/downstream plasma pair, with either a bounded 3-D normal and upstream-flow/thermal constraints consistent with the intended R132 closure, or an independently bounded signed magnetic-strength jump under the same ideal-MHD state-pair interpretation.
unresolved_regions: Zero new guarded roots happened to be hit by this finite stress grid; this does not certify guard-free interiors. All frozen R132 numerical unresolved nodes/cells and R133 observational insufficiency remain explicitly preserved.

conditional_reference_spectra_check.meaning: Both frozen families contain physically checked states near the free-ratio optimum of the conditional reference-spectrum comparison. These are not measured angles, family probabilities or proof that the reference plasma is upstream.
